entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Tomorrow's the end of the first semester,[n]but we still got all this lame shit[n]comin' up...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If you don't take care of this "lame shit,"[n]you can kiss your summer vacation[n]goodbye.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah, about this Futaba Sakura girl...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If she's related to Boss, think people[n]livin' nearby would know about her?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's some keen intuition coming from[n]you, Ryuji. You should have made use[n]of that on your exams.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, I never wanna think about exams[n]ever again...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyway, askin' around in your[n]neighborhood might be the fastest way[n]to figure this shit out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Then again, I doubt it'll be that easy.[n]It never is...
